tan-distressed-double-zip-backpack.name: Tan Distressed Double-Zip Backpack
tan-distressed-double-zip-backpack.description: A tan distressed-finish backpack with an upper zipped pocket and a larger lower zipped compartment. See the supplied photographs for the visible design. Material composition, measurements and capacity are awaiting supplier confirmation.

black-centre-seam-backpack.name: Black Centre-Seam Backpack
